method: Sequential requests through one httpx client; no retries or excluded warmup. Client wall time from before POST to complete HTTP response; includes network, provider processing and generation. Not time to first token or end-to-end detection latency.
inputs: Synthetic telemetry cards; no factory telemetry or database writes.
